title: Fix Customer Lookbook Hotspot Card Bottom Clipping with Dynamic Directional Smart Popover Positioning
description: Per user directive ('Living with Craft • Real Homes section when we click on some of the selection the info box gets cliiped at the bottom of the container fix that.'), resolved bottom clipping of the hotspot info card in CustomerLookbook (components/home/customer-lookbook.tsx). Hotspots in the lower half of the scene dropzone (y > 42%, such as salon-oak-mini at y:56%, credenza-natural-oak at y:46%, and bedside-deep-walnut at y:52%) now dynamically pop UPWARDS above the pin (sm:bottom-[calc(100%-y%+16px)] sm:top-auto), completely eliminating bottom overflow against the overflow-hidden scene container. Pins in the upper half continue to pop downwards (sm:top-[calc(y%+16px)] sm:bottom-auto). Horizontal coordinates are clamped between 26% and 74%, and safety max-height (sm:max-h-[calc(100%-24px)] overflow-y-auto) guarantees zero clipping under all viewports and zoom levels. Full test suite (69/69 tests) passes with 100% pass rate and 0 build errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Hotspots in lower half of container (y > 42%) position card above pin via sm:bottom-[var(--pin-bottom)] with bottom: calc(100% - y% + 16px) and sm:top-auto
Hotspots in upper half of container (y <= 42%) position card below pin via sm:top-[var(--pin-y)] with top: calc(y% + 16px) and sm:bottom-auto
Horizontal coordinate clamped between 26% and 74% with sm:-translate-x-1/2 centering
Container safety bounds enforced via max-h-[85%] sm:max-h-[calc(100%-24px)] overflow-y-auto
Mobile layout preserves inset-x-3 bottom-3 docking and testId preservation
All data-testids preserved: lookbook-scene-dropzone, lookbook-card-*, lookbook-hotspot-pin-*, lookbook-buyer-badge-*, lookbook-shop-link-*, lookbook-room-tab-*
Automated Playwright test spec tests/task-26-lookbook-clipping.spec.ts verifies zero top/bottom clipping across all 3 rooms and all pins with mathematical bounding box assertions

High-res visual proof screenshots captured: task-26-lookbook-lower-pin-no-clipping-dark.png, task-26-lookbook-lower-pin-no-clipping-light.png, and task-26-lookbook-all-rooms-verified.png in .agent/screenshots/ and parent brain directory
npm run build compiles with 0 errors across 13/13 static routes
Full Playwright test suite passes with 100% pass rate (69/69 passed in 43.6s)

steps.description: Analyze root cause of clipping in CustomerLookbook
steps.details: Identified that lookbook-scene-dropzone uses overflow-hidden, and lookbook-card-* previously used a static offset below the pin (--pin-y: Math.min(65, activeHotspot.y + 14)%). Lower pins (y:46-56%) pushed the ~280px tall card past the 100% container boundary.

steps.description: Implement Dynamic Directional Smart Popover Positioning in components/home/customer-lookbook.tsx
steps.details: Added isLowerHalf check (y > 42) to position cards above the pin (sm:bottom-[var(--pin-bottom)] sm:top-auto) when in the lower half and below the pin (sm:top-[var(--pin-y)] sm:bottom-auto) in the upper half. Applied clampedX between 26% and 74%, safety max-h-[85%] sm:max-h-[calc(100%-24px)] overflow-y-auto, and preserved all data-testid attributes.

Created comprehensive test spec cycling through all 3 rooms (living-room, dining-credenza, minimalist-bedside), verifying all 7 pins (including lower-half pins salon-oak-mini, credenza-natural-oak, and bedside-deep-walnut), asserting cardBox.y >= containerBox.y and cardBox.y + cardBox.height <= containerBox.y + containerBox.height + 2, and checking shop link CTA visibility.

Captured task-26-lookbook-lower-pin-no-clipping-dark.png, task-26-lookbook-lower-pin-no-clipping-light.png, and task-26-lookbook-all-rooms-verified.png in .agent/screenshots/ and copied to /Users/pritish/.gemini/antigravity/brain/91fc1fed-fc5f-495e-88c1-129ef76052af/.

steps.description: Run quality gates: npm run build and full Playwright test suite
steps.details: Verified npm run build compiles with 0 errors across 13/13 static routes and full Playwright test suite passes (69/69 passed with 100% pass rate).
